findings.text: bats_execute now sets PATH to $BATS_SAVED_PATH, but nothing in the change defines that variable. The diff only renames the reference from BATS_PATH, and the repo has no other definition. If the variable is unset, PATH becomes empty, so any command bats_execute runs by bare name (for example `bats_execute sort`) fails with 'command not found'. It also stops protecting internals from PATH mocks as intended. Either define BATS_SAVED_PATH or revert to BATS_PATH.
